# The go build reference cases. capture.sh and TestGoBuild both read this
# file. Each line is:
#
#	name  cwd  package  [-e]
#
# name:    the output is saved in want/<name>.txt
# cwd:     the current folder of go build, relative to m/; DEEP is a folder
#          inside m/ so deep that go build shows absolute paths
# package: the package folder, relative to m/
# -e:      go build -gcflags=-e (no limit of 10 errors)

# How file paths are shown.
cwd             .     .
subdir          .     sub
parent          sub   .
sibling         sub   two
absolute        DEEP  two

# Several files and their order.
two             .     two
order           .     order

# The limit of 10 errors.
nine            .     nine
ten             .     ten
eleven          .     eleven
twelve-e        .     twelve  -e
reportorder     .     reportorder

# Duplicates.
dups            .     dups
dups-e          .     dups    -e
interleave      .     interleave
samelinecount   .     samelinecount

# Messages with more places or more lines.
redecl          .     redecl
redecl-parent   sub   redecl
redecl-absolute DEEP  redecl
samepos         .     samepos
multiline       .     multiline
